context: Hina makes up names for her stuffed animals with Sho.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、このうさぎ、名前、考えて。
lines.en: Sho — think of a name for this rabbit!
lines.style: Bright, unfiltered eight-year-old energy. Rapid delivery, genuine excitement. Leans in slightly, waiting for his answer like it matters deeply.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うーん、ぴょんちゃん、どう？
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful six-year-old voice. Soft spoken, each word careful. Slight upward lilt at the end—uncertain but hopeful, offering the idea gently.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ぴょんちゃん、すごく可愛い名前！
lines.en: Pyon-chan — that's such a cute name!
lines.style: Immediate, bright affirmation. Voice rises with genuine delight. No pause—pure childish joy at liking his idea, delivered warm and whole.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 一緒に、もっと、考えよう。
lines.style: Soft six-year-old invitation. Small voice, but steady. Not asking permission—gently proposing, like he's thought of something worth doing with her.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 楽しい！全部に、名前、つけよう。
lines.en: Yes! Let's give names to all of them!
lines.style: High, infectious excitement. Words tumble out quickly. The joy of a plan forming in real time. Open, inclusive, unstoppable eight-year-old momentum.
